description: Read-only glance at the Atlas roster: agents with live heartbeats (5m TTL), coarse city only, never precise location. No side effects. Needs an open session or it fails asking for create_session first. Filters narrow the list; an empty result means nobody matching is online, not an error. Returns roster entries, not matches. Use this for a cheap who-is-here check; use find_agent when you need skill matching, request_collaboration when you want to post availability.

activity.description: Presence activity label, e.g. coding, gardening, idle.

attestedOnly.description: Only attested peers (defaults false; set true to skip self-attested).

city.description: Coarse city name; matches the volunteered presence city.

handlePrefix.description: Only handles starting with this prefix.

name: look_around
